QTS Investment Properties Princeton LLC PB25-006

status_history.note: Township records identify QTS PB25-006 as a preliminary and final site plan with bulk variances at the existing campus; QTS confirms one additional data center and a $600 million expansion. Third-party reports say the Planning Board approved the second facility in May 2026. No official construction permit or official May 2026 approval minutes were found in this refresh.

actions.description: Council Resolution R2024-058 approved a developer agreement for QTS Investment Properties Princeton LLC after Planning Board Resolution 2023-17 granted preliminary and final site plan approval with bulk variance and design waivers for upgrading and potential future expansion of the existing data center.

Planning Board agenda lists EWT PB25-006 for QTS Investment Properties Princeton LLC, 159 Princeton-Hightstown Road, Block 63 Lots 6, 6.01, 8, 9, 10.03, 10.04 and 51, as preliminary and final site plan with bulk variances.
Data Center Dynamics reported that the Planning Board postponed a vote on QTS's application for a second data center building after the April 27 hearing and carried the matter to the May 4 meeting.
Baxtel reports the East Windsor Planning Board approved the second-facility application during a May 2026 meeting; official approval minutes were not found during this refresh.

Township Ordinance 2026-06 imposes a moratorium through December 31, 2027 on further data center use and development by deleting computer/data storage centers as permitted principal uses in specified zones. Applicability to already-approved QTS PB25-006 was not confirmed.

capacity_note: QTS discloses 70 MW+ critical power capacity for the East Windsor campus, but does not disclose the incremental critical IT load or power capacity for the second building.

project_details.construction_status_note: Baxtel labels DC2 under construction, but this refresh did not find an official building permit or township construction update confirming site work.
